caishen-gold-infinity-dragon.description: A 5 × 3 grid retains twenty paylines, but triggers cascades after a win. Multipliers increase the next payout as the sequence develops.
caishen-gold-infinity-dragon.feature: Cascades continue one spin, free spins increase the value of a long sequence, and Bonus Buy offers an alternative route into the bonus.
caishen-gold-infinity-dragon.note: Mancala describes the game as a high-volatility cascade slot. Public release listings report RTP 95%.

money-booster.description: A compact 4 × 4 grid without a conventional payline layout. Payouts are read through matches across the grid, while special Booster symbols change the resulting values.
money-booster.feature: Coin Booster increases individual cash values. Free spins make more extensive use of multipliers and the special symbol set.
money-booster.note: The public version lists RTP 95%. Very High variance is grouped into High in the catalogue.

midas-hand-of-fortune.description: Forty paylines on a 5 × 3 grid with a golden-touch theme. The ordinary payline base is gradually enhanced by multiplier Wilds and free spins.
midas-hand-of-fortune.feature: Multiplier Wilds increase payline payouts. The bonus retains its emphasis on these symbols rather than switching to a different method of counting wins.
midas-hand-of-fortune.note: Public technical release catalogues report RTP 95% and high volatility.

mustang-rush.description: Twenty paylines on a 5 × 3 grid combine with a respin scenario, multiplier Wilds and fixed jackpot levels.
mustang-rush.feature: Special symbols retain the bonus state between respins. Multipliers and jackpot values determine the result after the ordinary payline trigger.
mustang-rush.note: Industry listings report RTP 95% and high volatility for the public version.

power-of-zeus-mancala.description: Twenty paylines and stacked multiplier Wilds lead into Hold & Earn, where coin symbols and jackpot levels persist on a separate bonus grid.
power-of-zeus-mancala.feature: Hold & Earn retains valuable positions between respins. Stacked multiplier Wilds increase ordinary payline combinations in the base game.
power-of-zeus-mancala.note: The published version lists RTP 95%. Distinguish this game from Hacksaw's Power of Ten and the Gates of Olympus series.

life-and-death.description: Six reels, five rows and 19 paylines centre on four Horsemen Wild Multipliers with values from 2x to 200x.
life-and-death.feature: Devastation and Reckoning develop expanding Wild reels. In Reckoning, activated Death Reels retain the ability to expand the associated multiplier on subsequent free spins.
life-and-death.note: Several RTP configurations exist. Slotfolio uses the upper public value of 96.36%, so check the active variant with the operator.

rad-maxx.description: A 5 × 5 grid uses payline direction as a changing state. Arrows around the grid determine the directions in which current wins are counted.
rad-maxx.feature: Crazy Cat Wilds carry 2x–20x multipliers. Wild Plus opens additional pay-direction arrows, and three bonus modes retain sticky Wilds.
rad-maxx.note: Official 1win material confirms 360 directions and maximum win 12 500x. The upper RTP of 96.32% comes from current technical catalogues and requires verification against the specific build.

777-coins.description: A compact 3 × 3 grid and five fixed paylines lead into Hold & Win. A central Collect symbol gathers coin values, while new symbols reset the respin counter.
777-coins.feature: Two Bonus symbols together with Collect trigger three respins. During the bonus, Collect stays in place and gathers values, while jackpot coins add Mini, Minor, Major and Grand levels.
777-coins.note: 3 Oaks' official page confirms the grid, five paylines, Hold & Win and Grand 2 000x with the possibility of tripling it to 6 000x. RTP 95.75% is a commonly listed reference configuration. Check the operator version in the game itself.
777-coins.metricsNote: 3 Oaks Gaming lists GRAND JACKPOT x2 000 and separately states that combining three COLLECT SYMBOLS with a GRAND JACKPOT SYMBOL can potentially triple the Grand Prize to x6 000. Slotfolio stores 6 000x as stated bonus-prize potential, rather than an independently published fixed maximum-win cap for the whole game.

3-hot-chillies.description: Twenty-five paylines and three coloured Chilli meters above the reels. Each pepper type is linked to its own Hold & Win modification and gradually charges the corresponding scenario.
3-hot-chillies.feature: During the bonus, sticky symbols remain between respins. Activated peppers can add multipliers, a fourth respin or a second grid. All three modifiers can operate together.
3-hot-chillies.note: 3 Oaks' official game page confirms a 5 × 3 grid, 25 paylines and three bonus modifiers. RTP 95.59% and medium volatility are used as a published reference configuration, rather than a guaranteed 1win setting.

egypt-fire.description: A 5 × 4 grid and twenty paylines lead into Hold & Win with Bonus and Mystery symbols. During the bonus, the grid can expand with additional rows as symbols accumulate.
egypt-fire.feature: Six Bonus and/or Mystery symbols trigger respins. Mystery symbols fill jackpot meters, new Bonus symbols stay on the grid, and a fully opened grid can raise Royal Jackpot to 10 000x.
egypt-fire.note: 3 Oaks officially describes a 5 × 4 grid, 20 paylines, expansion into additional rows, Free Spins and Royal Jackpot 10 000x. RTP 95.50% and high volatility are reference values from specialist catalogues. Check the operator configuration separately.
